name: BTC Exchange Whale Ratio
description: Top 10 Inflows / Total Inflows. Values close to 1 = whales dominating flows. Values close to 0 = retail dominating. Identifies if signal is from smart money or noise.
trading_signal: >0.7 → Whales are consolidating (strong signal, trust it). <0.3 → Retail noise (ignore or fade it).
